questions.prompt: ABCD is a parallelogram and M is the midpoint of diagonal AC. Explain, using the 180° rotation about M, why ∠DAB ≅ ∠BCD.

questions.correct_answer: The rotation maps ∠DAB onto ∠BCD, and rotations keep angle measure.
questions.required_method: Use that the rotation swaps A and C and maps the sides at A onto the sides at C.
